rows.evidence: Test src/server/services/pages-link-indexer.test.ts:224 '[ac:ac-resolve-i-autocomplete-path-md-sa-ogran] precedence: the source root wins, then the builtin root, then map order' asserts the indexer only: resolve('x.md','src.md','c')?.rootId → 'c', builtin before map order, and autocomplete(q, limit, sourceRootId) deduped from the precedence winner — always with an explicit sourceRootId. The resolve half holds end to end. The autocomplete half does not hold in the product: the editor's `@` mention source calls pageLinksApi.autocomplete(query, limit) (src/client/tiptap/registrations.ts:215-218), which never sends ?root= (src/client/lib/api.ts:486-491), and MentionSource.search has no context parameter (src/client/tiptap/registry.ts:282), even though the editor ctx knows rootId (registrations.ts:264). The route therefore always uses sourceRootId=null (src/server/routes/page-links.ts:34-37), and resolutionOrder starts at builtin (src/server/services/pages-link-indexer.ts:460-476). Result: on a page in a non-builtin root, a path that also exists in builtin is suggested from builtin (builtin title, rootId), but the inserted @path.md resolves to the source root. No test covers the route's ?root= or the client passing it.

Every clause holds except the source-root step of the editor's `@` suggestions. Holds: core-reactions.ts defines m06-anchor-injection (write-back, :72), m06-section-indexer (requires ['m06-anchor-injection'], requiresFlags ['references'], :86-93), m08-todos-indexer (:96), m14-link-indexer (:104), m14-rename-sync (:115), m17-capture (acceptsTracks ['file_version'], :128-134; filter enforced src/server/fs/reactions.ts:47,114). The indexer has no injection step and is the 8-step pass (src/server/services/section-indexer.ts:65,384; test section-indexer-integrity.test.ts:148). There is no separate plan anchor reaction: plans are injected by m06-anchor-injection's artifact write-back (project-context.ts:1532-1543); no plan-anchor reaction id is left in src. linkTargets is gone from src/shared and src/client and from runtime code; it appears only in legacy-key fixtures that assert it is dropped (config.ts:662, config.test.ts:328,507) and in comments. @path.md resolution covers every root selecting m14-link-indexer with source → builtin → roots[] order (pages-link-indexer.ts:320-385; project-context.ts:752,772-775). Missing: the editor's `@` suggestions skip the source root. The client never passes the editor's rootId (registrations.ts:215-218 → api.ts:486-491 sends only q/limit; MentionSource.search(query, limit) in registry.ts:282 cannot receive ctx.rootId). Suggestions always resolve from builtin first (pages-link-indexer.ts:460-476 with sourceRootId=null). On a page in a non-builtin root, a duplicated path is offered with builtin's title and rootId, while the inserted @path.md resolves to the source root. Deferred parts (kind-declaration binding → u03, plans source binding → u09) are not built against missing dependencies.

npm run typecheck exited 0 (tsc --noEmit clean in every workspace, last: @inharness-ai/c4s-plugin-ac@0.2.80). Stubs: .c4s-impl/stubs.json is {"stubs":[]}, so no open stub names u02-page-reactions as provider or dependent.
